name: Hangzhou Hikvision Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
constructed: An Alibaba.com buyer orders 2,000 IP cameras from a listing that names Hikvision as the manufacturer. The supplier is real; the proforma invoice is constructed: it asks for the 30% deposit by direct bank transfer outside Trade Assurance, to a Hong Kong account held by a trading company whose name is not the supplier's.

expect.why: The deposit would leave Trade Assurance and go to an account in another company's name, and the supplier sits on US export-control and non-SDN sanctions lists that an SDN-only screen does not cover.
